body:
Real, direct generalization of Result/Option's {Tag int; Value any} shape to arbitrary user-defined tagged unions, mirroring PARENA's own reference C emitter. One exported constructor per variant. v0 boundary: zero/single-field variants only, no match-on-defenum yet. go test: 99/99. Real end-to-end proof: ParseError defenum used as a Result's ErrorType, built/linked/run correctly. Commit 8a3e64b.

⚓ ☃
title: defenum support added to BURROW's Go emission target (cruise card 9988)
